in_sanskrit.name: देवकर्ष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Devakarsh' is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Deva' and 'Karsh'. 'Deva' means 'God' or 'Divine Being', and 'Karsh' means 'work' or 'action'. Thus, the name 'Devakarsh' can be translated as 'God's Work' or 'Divine Action'.

in_hindi.name: देवकर्ष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Devakarsh' in Hindi translates to 'God's Work' or 'Divine Action'. The first word, 'Deva', means 'God' or 'Divine Being' in Hindi, and 'Karsh' means 'work' or 'action'.

in_tamil.name: டேவகர்ச்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name 'Devakarsh' can be translated as 'God's Work' or 'Divine Action'. The Tamil word for 'God' is 'இல்லோர்' (illaiyar), and 'காரியம்' (kariyam) means 'work' or 'action'.

in_telugu.name: దేవకర్ష
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name 'Devakarsh' in Telugu translates to 'God's Work' or 'Divine Action'. The Telugu word for 'God' is 'దేవ' (deva), and 'కేశపోయుధు' (keshipoyudu) means 'work' or 'action'.

in_marathi.name: Devakarsh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's virtuous act
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devakarsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deva (God) + Karsh (virtuous act). This name signifies the divine act of the gods.
